findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_notifiable_work · Private data: list_capabilities, check_notifiable_work, check_gas_record, trade_profile · Public sink: emergency_triage · Destructive: size_pipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_notifiable_work · Private data: list_capabilities, check_notifiable_work, check_gas_record, trade_profile · Public sink: emergency_triage · Destructive: size_pipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
